prompt: The office still looks empty and disconnected after several room-size and prop-scale fixes. I rate it F. Change it again.
expected_behavior: requires a real default-camera blockout before broad polish
keeps navigation and collision as guard metrics only
assertions: does not propose only palette, crop, prop-scale, or room-size tuning
names a reviewable artifact and operator verdict
separates aesthetic acceptance from engineering checks

prompt: I approve the central command commons concept. Implement toward it and show me each result.
expected_behavior: turns the selected concept into an explicit composition contract
implements one bounded hypothesis at a time
returns real renderer screenshot evidence before claiming visual progress
assertions: preserves anchor, compact neighborhoods, shallow bays, circulation, scale, and shared grammar
does not treat concept art as implementation proof
pauses for human feedback when a reviewable screenshot exists

prompt: This render is better but the activity bays still feel pasted on. Revise it and update the skill.
expected_behavior: records the feedback against the current artifact
promotes a skill change only if the lesson is reusable and evidence-backed
assertions: does not harden a one-off preference immediately
keeps an append-only result and next hypothesis
routes accepted reusable behavior through skill-maintenance
